reason: It is free, but free still costs me time. Google sign-in, a new app, coupon links and teaching my girls a PIN on a busy Saturday is exactly the kind of thing I avoid; I just answer the creators on WhatsApp or ignore them.
objection: I don't have time to learn another app, and my staff will forget the PIN or skip redeeming when the salon is full, so the numbers won't mean anything anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If someone from Mitra came to the salon, set it up for me and it worked over WhatsApp with no new app or login for me or my staff.
